name: eq0hnw-needs-you-release-canary
goal: A Hub release cannot pass until a labelled test ask answered on prod Hub web, the Mac app and the iPhone is read back from the Tracker as answered by Daniel with the tapped option

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Regression: releases xrh3xx, qjgz2v, 138w2r were marked done with signed-in prod Hub unseen; on f0970f495b a web answer returned 'refused' with 0 queued rows (retro ecw4cy notes). Root cause: no release step answers a real ask on signed-in prod and reads it back. Spec: specification/features/planned/needs-you-release-canary.md

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Hub specs use hub-home-fixture (stored snapshot, mocked chat 'sent') or call deliverHomeChat directly; none run after a release or read the Tracker. Missing category: post-release live check. New reusable coverage: test/needs-you-canary.test.ts over the real tracker CLI parser and item rules

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Recorded at 3c4b668907 against the release gate that checks nothing: bunx vitest run test/needs-you-canary.test.ts, 8/8 failing, e.g. expected {} to deeply equal { web: 'passed', mac: 'passed', ... }. (Re-recorded once after a test-only fixture fix: its simulated tap could hit a closed ask.)

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Repair: scripts/needs-you-canary.ts raises one labelled ask per surface on a never-launching item, answers Hub web in its own automation-Chrome tab (Mac/iPhone by Daniel's tap), reads answered_by/answer_option/answer back, cleans up, records on the release item, flags+blocks it unless all pass. Guard: test/needs-you-canary.test.ts in test:unit

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: scripts/needs-you-canary.ts + scripts/needs-you-canary/* (aed3b04d; row selector fix after); test/needs-you-canary.test.ts runs in test:unit; packages/hub/README.md 'After a release'

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: loop record --phase green passed at aed3b04d with the three test files unchanged from red d2eef874: 8/8. Completed at that commit; main was merged afterwards and the 8 tests are rerun at the merged head.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Release gate reintroduced as check-nothing stub: 8/8 fail (red d2eef874), restored: 8/8 pass (aed3b04d). Also real Hub builds in isolated copies, headless: main 15882a2 (today's rows without buttons) rowLabels=[] so the canary fails 'no option buttons'; PR398 c006e628: labels Canary A,B,C,Other, press sent kind=answer option=2 to the linked Mac, 0 queued on the Hub: passed. First run on main returned null (selector needed PR398 markup); fixed in e6619f56 before this proof. Screenshots of both inspected (fixture data).

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: Ticked with this loop's green commit aed3b04d checked out, because the loop tool binds verify to the commit of the green record. The project checks ran on the LATER head 46321a0682, which contains aed3b04d: GitHub run 46006933300, parts static-unit, e2e-1, e2e-2, package, desktop and apps all succeeded in one run (Linux, 2026-11-27 16:27-17:10Z); together they are every step of bun run check (checkParts), incl. audit:root, units check and check:hub with its browser tests. A green record cannot be re-taken at that head: later fixes and main merges changed frozen test/config files. When recorded, the 'Full check' job, which only asserts the six results, was still queued. NOT run: macOS job 'Verify the exact commit' (no runner yet). No UI flow is changed (only UI-package file in the PR is packages/hub/README.md), so no new screenshots; the spec forbids screenshots of the live Hub. First full live run (canary script files identical to the head, e7e6b06844, 15:02-16:03Z, run by deploy 0j8kry): Hub web passed (Daniel via Hub, option 3, tapped by hand); Mac app and iPhone not-seen (no tap in 30 min), so the guard held the release: result noted on 0j8kry, ask flagged, release still blocked, 3 test items closed. Mac and iPhone readback remain unproven on prod.
